regions.name: Bubble Bay
regions.subject: maths
regions.story: The bubble machine is jammed! Solve the maths puzzles of the bay, from counting fish to reading the ship's clock, to set it bubbling again.

regions.name: Whispering Woods
regions.subject: english
regions.story: The owls have lost their voices. Help them find their words again: spell them, join them and punctuate them, and the whole wood will sing.

regions.name: Crystal Caves
regions.subject: phonics
regions.story: The crystals have gone dark. Read the words carved into the cave, blend the sounds and spell them right to light the crystals one by one.

regions.name: Cloud Castle
regions.subject: science
regions.story: The castle's laboratory has gone dark. Run the experiments, sort the specimens and test your ideas to switch every lab light back on.

regions.name: Brainwave Big Top
regions.story: Roll up, roll up! The ringmaster's puzzles have got into a terrible muddle. Hunt for hidden words, fill the number grids, sweep for sneaky mines, crack the crossword, match the tiles, build number pyramids, follow number trails, play bingo, pair up the clocks, spell across the tightrope, sort the rings and line up the sentence parade to get the show back on the road.

regions.name: Crescendo Canyon
regions.subject: music
regions.story: The canyon's giant echo has fallen silent! Listen, play and read music to fill the band shell with song, so the echo sings back louder and louder.

regions.name: Compass Peak
regions.subject: geography
regions.story: The Great Globe on Compass Peak has stopped spinning and the explorers' maps have blown away! Find the continents, read the maps and follow the rivers to set the world turning again.

regions.name: Hourglass Heights
regions.subject: history
regions.story: The Great Hourglass has cracked, and moments from the past are spilling across the hills! Travel back in time, solve history's puzzles and fill the hourglass with golden sand again.

regions.name: Circuit Spire
regions.subject: computing
regions.story: The beacon on top of the Circuit Spire has gone dark and Bolt the robot is muddled! Write programs, squash bugs, send messages and stay safe online to power it up again.

regions.story: The meadow has lost its colours! Mix paints, spot shapes and meet great artists to paint it bright again.
